user.title: Set up PantryOS
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to PantryOS Core running on your NAS or another local server.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure PantryOS
reconfigure.description: Update the PantryOS Core URL or API token after moving Core to a different NAS address or rotating credentials.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate PantryOS
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a valid PantryOS API token for the configured PantryOS Core URL.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to PantryOS Core.
error.invalid_auth: The PantryOS API token was rejected.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid http:// or https:// PantryOS Core URL.
error.timeout: The request to PantryOS Core timed out.
error.unexpected_response: PantryOS Core returned an unexpected API response.

abort.wrong_instance: The configured PantryOS Core belongs to a different PantryOS instance.

add_item.name: Add inventory item
add_item.description: Add an inventory lot to PantryOS Core.

name.name: Item name
name.description: Product or food name to add.

quantity.name: Quantity
quantity.description: Decimal quantity for the new lot.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: Quantity unit such as count, oz, lb, g, kg, ml, l, cup, or serving.

location.name: Location
location.description: PantryOS location path or location name for the lot.

expires.name: Expiration date
expires.description: Date the item expires or should be used by.

opened.name: Opened
opened.description: Whether the item was already opened when added.

minimum_stock.name: Minimum stock
minimum_stock.description: Minimum preferred quantity for shopping suggestions.

barcode.name: Barcode
barcode.description: Optional barcode value associated with the product.

estimated_cost.name: Estimated cost
estimated_cost.description: Estimated total cost for the lot.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Optional list of labels for the item.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Optional household notes for the item.

delete_item.name: Delete inventory item
delete_item.description: Discard an inventory lot from PantryOS Core.

item_id.name: Item ID
item_id.description: PantryOS inventory lot ID to discard.

consume_item.name: Consume inventory item
consume_item.description: Record consumption from an inventory lot.

item_id.name: Item ID
item_id.description: PantryOS inventory lot ID to consume from.

quantity.name: Quantity
quantity.description: Decimal quantity to consume using the lot unit.

move_item.name: Move inventory item
move_item.description: Move an inventory lot to a different PantryOS location.

item_id.name: Item ID
item_id.description: PantryOS inventory lot ID to move.

location.name: Location
location.description: Destination PantryOS location path or location name.

open_item.name: Open inventory item
open_item.description: Mark an inventory lot as opened.

item_id.name: Item ID
item_id.description: PantryOS inventory lot ID to mark opened.

opened_at.name: Opened at
opened_at.description: Optional date or timestamp when the item was opened.

add_recipe.name: Add recipe
add_recipe.description: Create or update a recipe in PantryOS Core.

ingredients.name: Ingredients
ingredients.description: List of ingredient objects with name, quantity, and optional unit.

plan_meal.name: Plan meal
plan_meal.description: Add a recipe to the PantryOS meal plan.

day.name: Meal slot
day.description: Meal slot or day label to plan, such as Tonight.

recipe_name.name: Recipe name
recipe_name.description: Existing PantryOS recipe name to plan.

add_shopping_item.name: Add shopping item
add_shopping_item.description: Add a manual shopping demand to PantryOS Core.

name.name: Item name
name.description: Product or food name to shop for.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: Quantity unit for the shopping item.

source.name: Source
source.description: Optional source label for the shopping demand.

add_missing_to_shopping_list.name: Add missing recipe items
add_missing_to_shopping_list.description: Add missing ingredients for a PantryOS recipe to the shopping list idempotently.

recipe_name.name: Recipe name
recipe_name.description: Existing PantryOS recipe name to evaluate.

promote_suggested_purchases.name: Promote suggested purchases
promote_suggested_purchases.description: Move PantryOS minimum-stock suggestions into the active shopping list.

discard_item.name: Discard inventory item
discard_item.description: Discard an inventory lot with a reason for history and waste reporting.

item_id.name: Item ID
item_id.description: PantryOS inventory lot ID to discard.

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: Reason to record on the discard event.

rebuild_shopping.name: Rebuild shopping list
rebuild_shopping.description: Recalculate idempotent PantryOS shopping demand from current inventory and rules.

start_cooking.name: Start cooking session
start_cooking.description: Start a PantryOS cooking session for a recipe or ad hoc meal.

recipe_id.name: Recipe ID
recipe_id.description: Optional PantryOS recipe ID for the session.

recipe_name.name: Recipe name
recipe_name.description: Optional PantryOS recipe name for the session.

complete_cooking.name: Complete cooking session
complete_cooking.description: Complete a PantryOS cooking session and record allocations, leftovers, and notes.

session_id.name: Session ID
session_id.description: PantryOS cooking session ID to complete.

allocations.name: Allocations
allocations.description: Ingredient allocation objects to consume from inventory.

leftovers.name: Leftovers
leftovers.description: Leftover lot objects to add after cooking.

cancel_cooking.name: Cancel cooking session
cancel_cooking.description: Cancel an active PantryOS cooking session.

session_id.name: Session ID
session_id.description: PantryOS cooking session ID to cancel.

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: Reason to record for the cancellation.
